answer: Honest peers cross-attest work, but a sybil cluster forging identities hits a reef: every fake node needs its own stake, and rewards unlock only after sustained useful output, like nectar earned slowly by real bees. Each new agent must stake a bond before its first voyage into the network. Attacking costs scale linearly with fake identities while payouts stay capped, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
